declaredCell.bundler: webpack 4.46.0 configured by hand under webpack_config/

dependencyAcquisition.lifecycleScriptsRationale: The declared baseline was run as the repository declares it. No --ignore-scripts was applied, because this project carries native dependencies whose addons are produced by install lifecycle scripts; disabling them would have recorded an install that is not the declared one.

dependencyAcquisition.packageManager: yarn 1.22.19, acquired as the published npm tarball and extracted to .versionless/cache/react-mycrypto-pm/yarn-cli

packageManagerTarball.note: The Node 12.14.1 runtime bundles npm 6.13.4 only, so yarn classic had to be acquired separately. Its digest is recorded but was NOT checked against any signature or independently published checksum.

dependencyAcquisition.registryHostNote: codeload.github.com appears because the committed lockfile pins three MyCryptoHQ forks (js-md5, js-sha1, uuid-by-string) to GitHub tarballs. Those fetches are part of the committed dependency closure, not an out-of-band download.
dependencyAcquisition.warningNote: The install emitted 32 unmet or incorrect peer dependency warnings. They are recorded, not resolved, and none of them failed the install.

intent: Execute the repository-declared cell (x64 Node 12.14.1 under Rosetta 2) and record a deterministic production-build inventory for the mycrypto vertical.

network.notContacted: nodejs.org — the runtime tarball was already in cache and its digest re-verified on disk, so no re-fetch was needed.

purposes.codeload.github.com: the sealed source archive at the pinned revision, plus three lockfile-pinned MyCryptoHQ dependency forks fetched by yarn during install
purposes.registry.yarnpkg.com: dependency tarballs resolved from the committed lockfile during install

nonclaims: Two byte-identical build inventories establish determinism of this baseline on this host in this cell, over two consecutive runs. They establish no reproducibility on a different host, a different filesystem, or a different clock, and no behavioral property of the built application.
The declared cell was reached under Rosetta 2 translation, not on native x86_64 hardware. Nothing here establishes that the build behaves identically on a native x64 host.

A verified archive digest establishes byte agreement with what the host served for that revision. It establishes no signer authenticity: the annotated tag is unsigned, and the commit signature reported by the host was not independently verified against a key this unit holds.

The yarn 1.22.19 tarball digest was recorded as observed on download. It was not checked against any independently published checksum or signature, so it is a record of what was fetched, not a provenance claim.
A successful install and build establish no browser behavior, journey coverage, service-worker parity, migration feasibility, pilot status, production readiness, certification, or legal approval.
This is a wallet application. No key material, mnemonic, keystore, or example wallet was read, executed, or copied into evidence; the inventory records file paths and digests of build output only.
Lifecycle scripts ran, which means third-party install scripts executed in this cell. That is recorded as the declared behavior of this project, not endorsed as safe.

parity.target: none — this unit produced the declared-cell baseline only; no Vite or other target lane was attempted

runtime.note: The tarball acquired and SHASUMS-verified by the prior unit was still in cache. Its sha256 was recomputed on disk and matched, so it was not re-fetched.

source.digestRequirement: the recorded sha256 was required exactly; a mismatch was to be reported as blocked

stepStreamNote: Build stderr is webpack progress output and is summarised by digest and byte count only. The streams themselves were not copied into evidence.

blockersCleared.clearedBy: Rosetta 2 was installed on the host before this unit started. The same control probe that previously failed, /usr/bin/arch -x86_64 /usr/bin/true, now exits 0.
The sealed archive was re-fetched from the exact recorded codeload URL under consent VL-LEGACY-CORPUS-2026-08-10 and matched the recorded sha256 exactly.

supersedes.relationship: That record remains retained and truthful for the host state at the time it was written: Rosetta 2 was absent and the sealed source archive was not in cache. Both blockers were cleared before this unit ran. It is superseded only as the current build profile for this fixture; it is not corrected, withdrawn, or rewritten.
